safety_controls.diagnostic_sink_lifetime: With writer allocated after preparation, one768row/300000byte-headroom/8192byte-allocation-name candidate denies during emission where immediate routing succeeds. This is not the production writer lifetime. With writer already alive before preparation, all six matched headroom cases complete; two candidate cases observe pre-emission retry. Initial result retained as a consumer-lifetime limitation, not a current-dispatch failure.
safety_controls.shared_admission: Three matched local and three matched genuinely shared-pool parent controls retain exact metadata/row-frame parity and release grants/files;2500x128 case observes retry. Scaled local workspace settings are synthetic, not supported CLI memory settings or retry occurrence estimates.
safety_controls.terminal_boundaries: Pre-cancel, malformed record limit, first sink row, eighth sink row, sink I/O and sink end denial each perform one scan with cleanup; partial output is never replayed. These are bounded injection controls, not every cancellation/device-fault timing.
safety_controls.native_acceptance: Fresh format, workspace/all-target Clippy and full locked default workspace suite pass for safety and native-instrumented snapshots. Auxiliary pressure source format/build/bin Clippy passes separately.
safety_controls.browser_acceptance: 35 default contracts plus bridge/peer cleanup, temporary/persistent interruption, persistent process-kill and direct-process-kill recovery, base and shuffle-partition resource reactors pass installed Chrome156.0.8078.48. Tested asset copies retained before rebuilding. Final isolated candidate package restored to seven default-feature test-free files.

decision: Retain unapplied candidate for targeted broader evaluation: fitting native/Chrome pass reduction and bounded recovery supported. Do not promote to production or calibrate a selector from these small cells. Forced retry adds logical I/O/files, and elapsed differences are mixed/inconclusive.
limitations: n2 per cell in fitting CLI/API-pressure/browser panels; n1 at shared2MiB; no significance/tails, cross-corpus or scale claim.
Cache/startup/host load uncontrolled; API, CLI and browser clocks are separate populations.
Engine diagnostics report logical temporary traffic snapshots, not physical I/O; reservations and shared-pool peaks are not RSS and competitor-inclusive peaks are not job-only usage.
No arbitrary shared-pressure success-domain inclusion, post-preparation pressure/emission admission guarantee or every cancellation/device/quota fault.
Browser fitting case uses OPFS picker handles; no browser forced-retry-cost or native File System Access throughput claim.
Raw attempts, logs, sources, binaries, tested/final packages and manifests remain in retained private local task roots; no new R2 upload, cleanup or public raw publication is claimed.
